paper: Profit Mirage: Revisiting Information Leakage in LLM-based Financial Agents
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored leakage-safe FactFin reconstruction using explicit price/factor/news state code, pre-common UCB tree search, and counterfactual validation; not FinLeak-Bench and not the unreleased GPT-4o-generated FactFin program.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: FactFin maps real-time price, factor, and factorized-news state into executable buy/sell/hold strategy code and iteratively evolves it rather than asking an LLM for direct historical predictions.
A Strategy Code Generator receives only structured state extracted by RAG, including quantified news, so the policy must depend on supplied inputs rather than memorized outcomes.
Monte Carlo Tree Search evolves strategy variants using UCB selection with depth ten and exploration constant 0.5, evaluating executable strategies on historical data.
A Counterfactual Simulator perturbs price, factor, and news inputs and favors strategies with low prediction consistency, low confidence invariance, and high input dependency.

strategy_code_grammar.program: score = w_price * price_state + w_factors * factor_state + w_news * factorized_news_state
strategy_code_grammar.normalization: divide by L1 norm after each mutation

search_and_counterfactual_policy.counterfactual_perturbation: cyclically choose one state group and independently permute that group across stocks within every validation month
search_and_counterfactual_policy.prediction_consistency: fraction of sell/hold/buy actions unchanged after perturbation
search_and_counterfactual_policy.confidence_invariance: one minus mean absolute change in clipped absolute strategy confidence
search_and_counterfactual_policy.input_dependency_score: mean KL divergence between three-action softmax distributions before and after perturbation
search_and_counterfactual_policy.final_selection: highest counterfactual objective among ten best training-reward nodes with lexical weight tie-breaking
search_and_counterfactual_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: apply the fixed selected continuous program score to frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: separate Strategy Code Generator, RAG, MCTS, and Counterfactual Simulator stages
explicit executable strategy code rather than direct LLM predictions
price, market-factor, and factorized-news state groups
buy, sell, and hold action semantics
MCTS depth ten and exploration constant 0.5
factual performance evaluation before final selection
prediction consistency, confidence invariance, and input dependency metrics
selection pressure toward strategies whose outputs respond to supplied inputs
approximated_elements: JKP price, factor, and surprise ranks replace Yahoo/Alpaca rows and RAG documents
a typed three-weight program replaces GPT-4o-generated source code
weight mutations replace unavailable SCG modification prompts
training RankIC replaces the unspecified native strategy evaluator
within-month state permutation replaces unreleased counterfactual generators
a pre-common train-validation split replaces the paper's unidentified model-development split
the common monthly decile portfolio replaces missing action sizing and execution
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP state groups
the three-weight code grammar, mutation step, and bounds
the 100-iteration MCTS budget and random seed
the three-action probability mapping used for KL divergence
